svg.title: Figure 3-SG-07-1. SG-07: from the fault tree to the FMEA
svg.desc: Figure 3-SG-07-1. SG-07: 21 events (backed 15, by design 1, external 1, unbacked 4); 22 FMEA modes reach SG-07 (in the tree 18, justified 2, tree gaps 2). Single points: BE-7.01: DFM-004, DFM-006, SWF-018, 3 causes, D 7–8, not detected; BE-7.02: no FMEA row yet; No SW FMEA mode for the power-save command 0xe7 accepted in a car mode (FFI-CM-08, TSR-513). F-17; BE-7.03: no FMEA row yet; No SW FMEA mode for the bus configuration commands 0xe5, 0xde, 0xf1 accepted in a car mode (FFI-CM-09, TSR-513). F-17; BE-7.04: no FMEA row yet; No SW FMEA mode for forwarding queue overflow or latency under worst-case load (TSR-707; can_common.h:165). F-17; BE-7.05: SWF-011, 1 causes, D 3, every cause D ≤ 4: tree and FMEA disagree; BE-7.06: FMEDA rows, no FMEA cause; FMEDA fmeda-sg009:FMD-017, fmeda-sg009:FMD-011; BE-7.11: PFM-008, PFM-006, PFM-014, 3 causes, D 8–9, not detected; BE-7.12: DFM-013, 1 causes, D 10, not detected; BE-7.17: DFM-020, 2 causes, D 10, not detected; BE-7.18: DFM-021, 1 causes, D 10, not detected; BE-7.19: DFM-008, 1 causes, D 10, not detected; BE-7.13: SFM-036, SWF-093, 4 causes, D 4–10, partly detected. BE-7.01 (MCU hang with the relay energised (no IWDG; GAP-07, GAP-43) 2026-10-12: IWDG reset ≤ ≈ 90 ms nominal (TSR-501); residual: hang-to-reset plus relay drop-out against the 0.2 s FTTI) → DFM-004, DFM-006, SWF-018: MCU execution stops with the relay energised; worst cause DFM-004.C1 (Hang in an ISR or main loop, unused vector to Default_Handler, or assert_fatal loop; O 3, D 8, AP H); detection: Watchdog HIL test with injected hangs (FAULT_INJECTION build); targeted, not yet run (no HIL bench, D-04) BE-7.02 (Power-save command 0xe7 in car mode stops the camera-side bus (FFI-CM-08)): No FMEA row yet; No SW FMEA mode for the power-save command 0xe7 accepted in a car mode (FFI-CM-08, TSR-513). F-17 BE-7.03 (Other SoC configuration commands disturb bus 2 (0xe5, 0xde, 0xf1; FFI-CM-09)): No FMEA row yet; No SW FMEA mode for the bus configuration commands 0xe5, 0xde, 0xf1 accepted in a car mode (FFI-CM-09, TSR-513). F-17 BE-7.04 (Forwarding queue overflow or latency under worst-case load (TSR-707 not verified; overflow counted only, can_common.h:165)): No FMEA row yet; No SW FMEA mode for forwarding queue overflow or latency under worst-case load (TSR-707; can_common.h:165). F-17 BE-7.05 (Block list wrongly includes a PCS message (systematic; static list safety.h:270-281)) → SWF-011: Stock pre-collision (AEB) messages blocked; worst cause SWF-011.C1 (TX table change marks 0x283/0x344 check_relay, or a forwarding defect; at BL-001 both are check_relay=false and forwarded (toyota.h:22-23); O 5, D 3, AP H); detection: opendbc safety suite with 100% line coverage and mutation tests, run by fork CI on every change (.github/workflows/safety.yaml, CR-CI-05). At BL-002 the Toyota tests pass locally (287, 34 skipped); mutation was last run locally at BL-001 (2705/2705 killed). Tests are derived from the implementation, not from requirements BE-7.06 (Camera-side FDCAN or transceiver fault (random HW)): FMEDA rows, no FMEA failure mode; fmeda-sg009:FMD-017, fmeda-sg009:FMD-011 BE-7.07 (0x344, 0x411 and DSU IDs in the TX whitelist without a content check (modes/toyota.h:19-32; GAP-42) 2026-10-12: removed in the reference build (TSR-705; 0x411 kept in other builds)): No FMEA row yet; No SW FMEA mode for 0x344, 0x411 or DSU IDs in the TX whitelist without a content check (GAP-42, TSR-705; removed in the reference build). SFM-035.C3 of the System FMEA is the only row. F-17 BE-7.08 (SoC sends such a frame (QM fault or compromise)) → SFM-035: Item sends a frame that alters the stock pre-collision function; worst cause SFM-035.C1 (Host code (car interface, pandad) emits a PCS-relevant ID or a non-zero PRE_COLLISION payload (QM fault); O 6, D 9, AP H); detection: process_replay over the CI route corpus compares sendcan with the reference commit; a regression check, not designed or proven for this cause BE-7.09 (Analog switch U1 or U2 stuck in intercept, or its IN input damaged high; no switch-position feedback, readback not pursued (GAP-12; RR-2026-010 F-06; DQ-209 A)) → DFM-010, SFM-034: Intercept switch stays in intercept when released; worst cause DFM-010.C4 (U1/U2 overstressed or latched up by box supply transients above the DG419LE absolute maximum (V+ = VL = VIN with no regulator; the SMF16A clamp D4 only starts to conduct above its 16 V stand-off). Damage can leave the switch in either position or open a channel (also DFM-011, DFM-013); O 4, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) BE-7.15 (SBU1 drive stuck high (device-side driver or MCU pin, UK-06)) → DFM-010: Intercept switch stays in intercept when released; worst cause DFM-010.C4 (U1/U2 overstressed or latched up by box supply transients above the DG419LE absolute maximum (V+ = VL = VIN with no regulator; the SMF16A clamp D4 only starts to conduct above its 16 V stand-off). Damage can leave the switch in either position or open a channel (also DFM-011, DFM-013); O 4, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) BE-7.16 (Pull-down R2 or R3 open: IN floats when SBU1 is undriven, so the switches may stay in intercept (RR-2026-010 F-03; bench test VS-HW-23)) → DFM-010: Intercept switch stays in intercept when released; worst cause DFM-010.C4 (U1/U2 overstressed or latched up by box supply transients above the DG419LE absolute maximum (V+ = VL = VIN with no regulator; the SMF16A clamp D4 only starts to conduct above its 16 V stand-off). Damage can leave the switch in either position or open a channel (also DFM-011, DFM-013); O 4, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) BE-7.10 (Forwarding not running (device off, MCU in reset or bootloader)) → DFM-004, DFM-016: MCU execution stops with the relay energised; worst cause DFM-016.C1 (SoC drives STM_BOOT0/STM_RST_N (fault or compromise); no RDP/WRP; pandad recovery flashes a development bootstub; O 4, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) BE-7.11 (Connector intermittent or partly seated (SFM-015.C3; DFI-05, DFI-20)) → PFM-008, PFM-006, PFM-014: Harness connector not fully latched; worst cause PFM-014.C1 (Log review of forwarded and intercepted messages is manual and needs tools the installer may not have; O 8, D 9, AP H); detection: relayMalfunction alert covers only the relay-not-intercepting case BE-7.12 (Stock camera path open inside the harness box (U1/U2 channel open, solder joint, contact; the path is not passive, accepted with comma's box, DQ-209 A; RR-2026-010 F-01)) → DFM-013: Stock camera path open inside the harness box; worst cause DFM-013.C1 (Open in the harness box stock path (U1/U2 channel open, solder joint, connector contact); O 3, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) BE-7.17 (Harness box loses its supply while the car is on: U1/U2 unpowered, pass-through not guaranteed, D2/D3 clamp CAN0/CAN2 to the dead rail (derived from the v3 drawing; bench test VS-HW-22, DQ-209 A; RR-2026-010 F-02)) → DFM-020: Harness box loses its supply while the car is on; worst cause DFM-020.C1 (Ignition branch to the box open (crimp, connector) or D1 open, without comma power installed; O 5, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) BE-7.18 (Clamp diode D2 or D3 short or leaky: loads or grounds a vehicle bus in either switch state (RR-2026-010 F-07)) → DFM-021: Clamp diode short loads or grounds a vehicle bus in the harness box; worst cause DFM-021.C1 (Schottky clamp D2 or D3 (BAS40SDW) short or leaky; O 3, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04) BE-7.19 (Car-side transceiver holds bus 0 dominant (TXD stuck low)) → DFM-008: Car-side transceiver holds the bus dominant; worst cause DFM-008.C1 (XCVR1 TX driver fault or TXD stuck low; O 3, D 10, AP H); detection: No LionDriver hardware verification or qualification test exists for this cause (WP-H-06/WP-H-07 not started; no HIL bench, D-04)
